decisions.reason: The necessary GPIO3-to-GPIO5 change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY of enable_gpio.
Changing the 5V_EN control GPIO does not alter the standalone USB 3.3V power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the Schottky OR-ing topology or selection behavior between the two 3.3V sources.
The charge-status indicator remains the GPIO13-driven SK6812 chain; the separate 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not necessarily change this requirement.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already fully records 5V_EN on GPIO5 and the source's SCL0 and SPI MOSI reassignments.
The 5V_EN GPIO change does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology, battery input range, or normal battery power path.
The source decision concerns 5V_EN and unrelated GPIO assignments, not the battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
The signal connector still carries the logical 5V_EN net on pin 7; changing the ESP32 GPIO driving that net does not change the interboard connector pinout.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the LED board's required count or addressable LED type.
Although the source moves SCL0 to another GPIO, it does not change the I2C bus speed, cable length, pull-up resistance or location, or series-resistor policy.
The GPIO reassignment has no necessary effect on overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other battery-protection behavior.
The battery NTC connection through J_BAT is independent of the 5V_EN GPIO reassignment.
